participation.context: Refused the spare again in the telling, and asked about oats.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Priced three houses and the oats, and would not move the forty.
participation.name: Thomas Hobbins

relations.note: a price he will answer, and a price he will not invent
relations.quote: Forty pound is her no, not your sum.

story.body: You let him tell the houses, and you spent the question you had on oats. The widow's forty pound stayed at Wheatley. You still do not know whose the house by the chapel is.

relations.note: a price he will answer, and a price he will not invent
relations.quote: Forty pound is her no, not your sum.

participation.context: Set the pack down and took the boots off. His face is not in the picture.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You put down what the day had been carried in, and you left them where the floor could have them.

title: Set the pack and the boots on the floor
